decisions.reason: As a specialized naval product with likely long qualification and sales cycles, it remains a viable option to keep open and its survival into 2024 suggests the firm has not yet seen evidence strong enough to abandon it.

Although general interior lighting is a more competitive and easier-to-replace segment, the product’s continued presence after launch indicates acceptable traction and a large incumbent can keep it in the portfolio at relatively low option-maintenance cost.

Because it was still being actively highlighted in 2024, the firm appears to be continuing to test and support this luminaire, so real-options logic favors keeping it rather than closing the option now.
The product’s continuation while a related marine searchlight was removed suggests it is the stronger surviving option in that niche, making retention the more likely choice for the coming year.
